comment: Keys, values, messages and numbers of the Core 2 player reaction stack (WP-10, docs/design/11): the offer a hit opens, the options it lists, the stack the answers build and the intents that drive it.

keySets.name: Core2ReactionKeys
keySets.doc: Keys of the reaction state (web pendingReaction, reactionStack, reactionResume, reactionCursor), of an option and of the play it commits, and of the rules the stack reads.

keySets.name: Core2ReactionValues
keySets.doc: Values the reaction stack compares or writes: the events, the reasons a card is not offered or a stacked card fizzles, the stages of the enemy phase and the intent types.

keySets.name: Core2ReactionMessages
keySets.doc: Messages of the reaction stack: what an answer or a switch refuses, and what a play refused as a reaction says.

keys.ChangeBetweenActions: Change reactions between actions on the player turn
keys.CounterReturnUnreachable: The selected Counter return cannot reach its attacker
keys.IncomingResolved: The incoming action has already resolved
keys.NoIncomingAction: The reaction stack has no incoming action
keys.NoLongerPlayable: That reaction card is no longer playable
keys.NotEnoughMana: Not enough mana to play this card
keys.NotEnoughStamina: Not enough Actions (Stamina) to play this card
keys.ReactionPreference: Reaction preference must be enabled or disabled
keys.ReactionRulesVersionOne: Core 2 combat: reaction rules version 1 is not part of a Core 2 run
keys.ReactionsUnavailable: Optional reactions are unavailable in this saved combat
keys.UpcastNotPorted: Core 2 combat: an upcast reaction card is not part of a Core 2 run

keySets.name: Core2AutoReactionKeys
keySets.doc: Keys of auto-combat's reaction chooser state (web model/autoCombatPolicy.js): the seat's intent, last stance and manual picks, and the matchup table.

keySets.name: Core2AutoReactionValues
keySets.doc: The maneuver words a perceived intent or a last stance is read in, and the maneuvers they are normalized to.

numberSets.name: Core2ReactionNumbers
numberSets.doc: Numbers of the reaction stack: how far a refusal got (a candidate is reported by the first failing check of the one that got furthest), and the hits that make a root worth one more receipt.
